To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ISeeCube tool supports the visual analysis of gaze points and dynamic AOIs for video.
we introduce a new design of visualizations for the analysis of gaze data, which supports multiple analysis tasks and is based on the concept of a space-time cube.
ISeeCube is a novel visualization tool that supports the visual analysis of gaze tracking data recorded from unlabled videos.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of an interactive visual analytics system for the spatiatemporal analysis and exploration of gaze data recorded for video stimuli.
the development of new methods and tools for the visual analysis and exploration of eye tracking video data.
the visual analysis of gaze behavior in the context of dynamic video stimuli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ISeeCube is a powerful and easy to use tool for visual analysis of gaze tracking data recorded from video.
the ISeeCube system is a very good example of how the combination of different visualizations, in this case, can support a variety of different analysis tasks.
the visual analysis of the gaze data with ISeeCube is a very useful tool for researchers in the area of eye tracking.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the visual analytics techniques presented in this thesis enable the analysis of eye tracking videos with a high level of detail and precision, which is essential for a wide range and number of applications.
we present an integrated visual analytics approach for the analysis of gaze data from unlabeled videos, which supports the exploration of multiple aspects of the data at once.
ISeeCube supports the exploration of gaze data for unlabeled video and provides the possibility to annotate the video and AOIs for the analysis of labeled video.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of multiple coordinated views can be used to support the analysis of eye tracking videos in a more efficient way.
the combination of different visual analytics techniques can provide a rich and flexible environment for the analysis of eye tracking videos.
a visual analytics approach can help to better understand and explain the behavior of multiple viewers in dynamic environments.
